allow.description: off = no one can message. mutuals = only people you both follow. everyone = anyone, but a first message from a non-mutual lands in Requests until you reply.

createdAt.description: When this preference was last set.

main.description: A user's chat privacy preference: who may start a conversation with them. This is a public policy flag (not message content), so storing it in a public repo is fine. One record per user (rkey 'self'). The server-side gate and the AppView indexer both enforce it. Carries the app.zeens.v marker.
